answer: An attacker forging many identities must pay the full bond per fake agent, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity where each agent must lock a bond tied to a verifiable off-chain credential, such as a signed hardware attestation. Like a sparrow defending one cedar perch, honest agents guard scarce credentials, and the fable of cheap pseudonyms collapses once each identity carries real collateral. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
